title: Plan spec quality
description: Reusable plan-level quality standard applied to one exact current specSetHash. Plans are rows; these criteria grade whether their clause set is safe to promote before implementation begins.

criteria.title: Every clause is the exact accepted current revision
criteria.model: Stable spec and VAL identities resolve uniquely; every relied-on row is the current immutable revision with content hash and acceptance provenance.
criteria.method: Read plans:get-specs current rows and verify unique ids/aliases, revision=currentRevision, contentHash, acceptedBy, and acceptanceRef.
criteria.driftMarkers: Duplicate aliases; a historical revision graded as current; an active row with no acceptance authority.

criteria.title: Every plan item owns behavior or an explicit exemption
criteria.model: Each plan item is covered by at least one active/accepted clause, or by a deliberate non-behavioral exemption; absence is never interpreted as non-behavioral.
criteria.method: Join current clauses by planItemId and list every uncovered plan item exactly.
criteria.driftMarkers: Implementation work with no clause; documentation/ops work silently omitted instead of explicitly exempted.

criteria.title: Clauses state one observable outcome
criteria.model: Each active clause is atomic and observable, not a bundle of separately testable outcomes.
criteria.method: Apply the canonical spec-clause compiler's atomicity checks to every active behavior.
criteria.driftMarkers: Multiple sentences; semicolon bundles; two observable verbs joined by and/or.

criteria.title: Every behavior can be shown false
criteria.model: The clause names a concrete outcome whose violation is observable; vague works-correctly or discretionary text does not qualify.
criteria.method: Apply the canonical compiler's falsifiability checks and report each failing spec id.
criteria.driftMarkers: Works correctly; TBD; as appropriate; a statement with no possible counterexample.

criteria.title: Contracts do not prescribe internal code shape
criteria.model: Clauses describe behavior at a boundary rather than filenames, functions, classes, variables, or other implementation constructs.
criteria.method: Inspect active behavior text for implementation filenames/constructs and rewrite matches as externally observable outcomes.
criteria.driftMarkers: handler.ts returns true; rename this method; set a private field.

criteria.title: Non-behavioral work is exempted explicitly
criteria.model: An exemption is valid only when lifecycleStatus=exempt, behaviorClass=non-automated, and both justification and provenance are recorded.
criteria.method: Validate every exempt current clause and refuse silent or mislabeled waivers.
criteria.driftMarkers: RequiresTest:false treated as a waiver; empty justification; behavioral clause mislabeled exempt.

criteria.title: Clause shape meets the current plan-class standard
criteria.model: Feature plans carry behavior; bugfixes carry failure/boundary regression contracts; migrations carry data-integrity contracts; investigations carry observability/non-automated contracts or explicit exemptions.
criteria.method: Evaluate the current behavior-class set against the chosen plan-class rubric.
criteria.driftMarkers: Bugfix with only a happy path; migration with no integrity clause; investigation with no observable finding contract.

criteria.title: The verdict is pinned to the exact current specSetHash
criteria.model: The scorecard subject includes the deterministic hash of the complete current clause set; any semantic revision invalidates the old verdict.
criteria.method: Recompute specSetHash from current clauses and require an exact complete terminal scorecard for that subject.
criteria.driftMarkers: A scorecard for an older hash accepted after a clause revision; a plan-wide green with no exact set identity.
